Basically in Deneb the `ExecutionPayload` of the beacon blocks changed in amount of fields such that the proofs change.
Proofs go from 11 to 12 digests, and GeneralizedIndex changes. For this reason we swapped to a List instead in the specs PR, so that the same type could remain to be used. 

But as I am now implementing this ... it feels counter productive. As it is not just the Vector size that changes but also the gIndex, so you would have to make a selection based on the slot number anyhow.
And when using a List, you also will need to check the size of the list, so then it seems like one might just as well go for the Vector, as it will give better type safety.

excerpts.author: deme1744
excerpts.content: But in terms of spec it does mean we would have to define a `BlockProofHistoricalSummariesDeneb`.
